meanings.en: to be ill, to be sick
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to be ill', paired with 'заболеть'.

examples.text: Я этого не хочу. Но вспомни, у тебя сын болеет.
examples.trans: I don't want that. But remember, your son is ill.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('important').

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.

meanings.note: винить кого в чём = blame someone for sth

examples.trans: He blames the weather for everything.

examples.text: Иван, перестань винить себя во всём!
examples.trans: Ivan, stop blaming yourself for everything!

examples.text: Лунтик две тысячи восемнадцать. Что смотрите? Внук приходил, играл!
examples.trans: Luntik two thousand eighteen. What are you looking at? My grandson came over and played!
She was running after me (around me).
She circled around me like a shark.

meanings.note: an idiom for a big telling-off

meanings.en: 'голову оторвать' = to tear someone's head off
meanings.note: an idiom for a big telling-off

examples.trans: Mum will tear my head off.

examples.text: Какая тебе опергруппа? Мне твоя мать голову оторвёт.
examples.trans: What field team? Your mother will tear my head off.

meanings.note: feminine noun, stress shifts in plural

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to live'.

examples.trans: I live in a communal flat.

examples.text: Я хочу нормально жить! Я хочу биде, понимаешь?
examples.trans: I want to live like a normal person! I want a bidet, do you understand?

meanings.note: the opposite of good: добро и зло = good and evil

examples.text: Запомните: зло всегда возвращается к правителю.
examples.trans: Remember: evil always comes back to the ruler.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.

meanings.note: оставь мне кусок = save me a piece

meanings.note: перестань(те)! = stop it!, oh come on!

examples.text: Да перестаньте! Я двадцать лет в карты не играла.
examples.trans: Oh, stop it! I haven't played cards for twenty years.

examples.text: Иначе я перестану давать тебе деньги!
examples.trans: Otherwise I'll stop giving you money!

понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?
